page.notes: Fragment at the head of the page: the first word "ctionis" is cut off at the left edge and is kept as printed. "entialicui" is printed with no visible space; it may be "enti alicui" (doubtful). "compacata" may read "compatata" (doubtful). "imperfectu" is printed as such (possible misprint for imperfectum). The line "10 An omnis ... vitiositatem ?" has a spaced question mark as printed. Stains and marks in the left margin are not transcribed.
